Class CaseMap

java.lang.Object
com.ibm.icu.text.CaseMap
Direct Known Subclasses:
CaseMap.Fold, CaseMap.Lower, CaseMap.Title, CaseMap.Upper
public abstract class CaseMap extends Object
Low-level case mapping options and methods. Immutable. "Setters" return instances with the union of the current and new options set.

This class is not intended for public subclassing.

Status:
Stable ICU 59.
